# HARMONY IA LÍA — public research index

> Public technical proposal for a human-compatible humanoid physical embodiment, design horizon 2032–2035.

Primary thesis: the main opportunity is integration of existing or emerging capabilities across lightweight structure, compliant actuation, proprioception, multimodal electronic skin, tactile manipulation, expressive HRI and safety-gated high-level AI interfaces.

Public pages/files:
- README.md — project thesis and scope
- docs/01_DESIGN_THESIS.md — physical design thesis
- docs/02_CONVERGENCE_MAP.md — independent technology references
- docs/03_FIVE_LAYER_SENSORIMOTOR_ENVELOPE.md — five-layer body/skin concept
- docs/04_MATERIALS_ACTUATION_CONTROL.md — materials and control relationships
- docs/05_PROPRIOCEPTION_TACTILE_HRI.md — sensory fusion and social interaction
- docs/06_AI_ROBOT_INTERFACE.md — safe high-level AI interface proposal
- docs/07_SAFETY_INTEROPERABILITY.md — safety boundaries
- docs/08_SOURCES.md — primary and academic sources
- docs/10_COMPUTE_MEMORY_STORAGE.md — proposed onboard compute, RAM, NVMe, real-time and safety domains
- PUBLIC_PRIVATE_BOUNDARY.md — disclosure limits
- LICENSE.md — CC BY-SA documentation license + exclusions

Private software, memory, prompts, datasets, internal repositories and proprietary implementation details are not part of this public artifact and have no public access path from this repository.

Canonical website: https://harmonyialia.com/
